name: Persona Gen 1

source.quote: Persona AI Inc., a humanoid robot and embodied artificial intelligence developer, this week said it has closed an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round, raising $27 million.
our human operators guide the robot through dexterous tasks in real time

capabilities.note: Persona AI's own account of a VR-headset-teleoperated welding test at ARC Specialties, Houston; explicitly described as human-guided, collecting data toward future autonomous operation.

source.quote: strike a lit torch, maintain a steady arc, and successfully lay down a weld path

capabilities.note: Same teleoperated welding-torch demo; robot squats, welds and stands back up under its own power while under human teleoperation.

timeline.detail: Persona AI (Houston) announced a $27M oversubscribed pre-seed round and said it had already signed an agreement with HD Hyundai to deploy humanoids into shipyards, with initial delivery expected within 18 months.

source.quote: Persona AI said it has already signed an agreement with HD Hyundai, a global leader in shipbuilding, to deploy humanoids into shipyards, with initial delivery expected within 18 months.

timeline.detail: Persona AI deployed a humanoid welding robot at its own Houston facility, sized to fit human welders' physical envelope in confined shipyard spaces; described as prototype/pre-commercial, with commercial testing targeted for 2027.

source.quote: The 175cm, 85kg robot is designed to fit the same physical envelope as human welders in confined shipyard spaces.

notes: Persona AI's own site (persona.ai) does not publish numeric specs (height/weight/DOF/speed/payload) for Gen 1; specs is left empty rather than sourced to press coverage. Press figures conflict: RobotAIGeek (Jul 2026, on-site Houston deployment) reports '175cm, 85kg', while other secondary aggregators (not traced to a manufacturer statement) report 175 cm / 70 kg and ~32 DOF. Neither height/weight pairing could be confirmed against a Persona AI-published spec sheet during this build.

A later RoboHorizon report (2025-12-31) describes a $42M pre-seed round for Persona AI's humanoid welding bot, which appears inconsistent with (or a follow-on close to) the $27M pre-seed reported in May 2025 by The Robot Report; both figures are recorded here as a discrepancy rather than resolved. See https://robohorizon.com/en-us/news/2025/12/persona-ai-unveils-humanoid-bot-with-42m-to-weld-in-shipyards/ (accessed 2026-09-20).

No named-customer unit with an invoice, serial number, or independent unboxing was found; the HD Hyundai relationship is a signed deployment agreement/MOU with initial delivery 'expected' within 18 months of May 2025, not a completed shipment. delivery.status is set to 'demonstrated' on the strength of the on-site Houston welding-robot deployment (RobotAIGeek, Jul 2026), not 'shipped'.
No public price has been found for Gen 1; Persona AI operates a robotics-as-a-service model without published unit pricing, so price_history is left empty.
